blocks.en: Graduate Common Competency Courses: List of Newly Established Courses
○ Course classification: Common (공통, open to all graduate programs)

- Basic competency: basic research competency (attitude and conduct as a researcher, academic writing and thesis writing, academic presentation and discussion, research ethics, etc.), teaching competency, career development competency, etc.
blocks.ko: - 기초역량: 연구기초역량(연구자의 자세 및 태도, 학술적 글쓰기·논문작성, 학술 발표 및 토론, 연구윤리 등), 교수(teaching) 역량, 진로개발 역량 등

blocks.en: - Interdisciplinary (convergence) competency: the ability to do research that combines one's own major with other academic fields
blocks.ko: - 융·복합역량: 전공 분야와 타 학문 분야를 융합하여 연구할 수 있는 역량

blocks.en: - Research competency: the ability to develop one's own research based on an in-depth understanding of research methodology
blocks.ko: - 연구역량: 연구방법론에 대한 심층적인 이해를 바탕으로 자신의 연구를 발전시켜나갈 수 있는 역량

blocks.en: This course aims to give graduate students a basic understanding of research ethics. The course will cover a wide range of topics, including scientific misconduct such as fabrication, falsification and plagiarism, cases of research ethics violations, and ethical issues in specialized fields such as bioethics and engineering ethics. By raising graduate students' awareness of the characteristics of the modern science and technology in their own major and of the ethical problems that may arise in research, this course can help prevent research misconduct or inappropriate conduct in advance and contribute to creating an environment for good research.
blocks.ko: 본 수업은 대학원생들을 위한 연구윤리의 기초적인 이해를 도모하는 것을 목표로 한다. 수업에서는 위조, 변조, 표절 같은 과학 부정 행위는 물론, 연구윤리 위반 사례, 생명윤리와 공학윤리와 같은 전문분야의 윤리적 주제들을 폭 넓게 다룰 것이다. 이 수업은 대학원생에게 자신이 전공하는 현대 과학기술의 특성과 연구에서 발생할 수 있는 윤리적인 문제에 대한 인식을 고양함으로써 연구 부정행위나 부적절 행위를 사전에 예방하고 좋은 연구를 위한 환경을 만드는 데 기여할 수 있다.

blocks.en: This course aims to promote a basic understanding of research ethics for science and engineering graduate students. The course will cover a wide range of ethical topics in specialized fields such as bioethics and engineering ethics, as well as scientific misconduct such as forgery, falsification, and plagiarism, along with several well-known cases of violation of research ethics. This class will contribute to preventing research misconduct or inappropriate conduct in advance and creating an environment for good research by raising awareness of the characteristics of modern science and technology as well as the ethical problems that may arise in research.
blocks.ko: This course aims to promote a basic understanding of research ethics for science and engineering graduate students. This class will contribute to preventing research misconduct or inappropriate conduct in advance and creating an environment for good research by raising awareness of the characteristics of modern science and technology as well as the ethical problems that may arise in research.

This course develops the ability to process relevant data for humanities research. It covers methodologies such as data construction, exploratory data analysis and inferential data analysis, and focuses on applying these methodologies to real humanities data.

3. 사회과학과 경영학을 위한 자료분석법 (Data Analytics for Social Sciences and Business) 3-3-0
blocks.ko: 3. 사회과학과 경영학을 위한 자료분석법 (Data Analytics for Social Sciences and Business) 3-3-0

blocks.en: In this course, students will learn the basic concepts and theories of probability and statistics, and acquire data analysis techniques for analyzing research data in the social sciences and business. The course covers probability, the concept and methods of estimation, probability distributions, the theoretical background of hypothesis testing, and data analysis techniques based on these, such as regression analysis and analysis of variance. Students will also learn how to analyze real data using the statistical package R.
blocks.ko: 이 강의에서는 확률과 통계에 대한 기초 개념과 이론을 학습하고, 사회과학과 경영학의 연구 자료를 분석하는 자료 분석 기법을 습득할 것이다. 이 강의에서 다루는 내용은 확률, 추정의 개념과 추정방식, 확률 분포, 가설 검증의 이론적 배경과 이를 바탕으로 한 회귀분석과 분산 분석과 같은 자료 분석 기법이다. 또한 통계 패키지인 R을 사용하여 실제 자료를 분석하는 방법들도 학습할 것이다.

blocks.en: This course aims to make students understand the basic concepts and theories of probability and statistics and acquire skills for applying the data-analytic techniques to research data in social sciences and business studies. Students study the concepts of probability, estimation, probability distribution, hypothesis testing, and data-analytic techniques such as regression and ANOVA. Students will also learn how to perform statistical analyses using statistical package R.
blocks.ko: This course aims to make students understand the basic concepts and theories of probability and statistics and acquire skills for applying the data-analytic techniques to research data in social sciences and business studies. Students study the concepts of probability, estimation, probability distribution, hypothesis testing, and data-analytic techniques such as regression and ANOVA. Students will also learn how to perform statistical analyses using statistical package R.

blocks.en: ※ Note: Graduate common competency course (Research competency)

This is a bioinformatics course for graduate students. Students learn basic data analysis and resource usage methods that are useful in biological research, such as (1) basic statistics and hypothesis testing methods (hypothesis testing, multiple testing correction, Bayesian statistics, etc.), (2) data visualization and regression analysis based on multivariate statistics (principal component analysis, multivariate regression analysis, extraction of key variables, etc.), (3) basic analysis of omics data (data pre-processing and normalization, mapping, selection of genes/proteins with differences in expression/activity), (4) target molecule prediction (microRNA and transcription factor target prediction, etc.), (5) artificial intelligence/machine learning techniques, (6) biological network modeling and analysis, and (7) bio data resources and their use (various databases and their use, such as genome browsers, genetic variation, protein modification, gene/protein expression levels and gene-disease associations). A term project is given in which students apply the methods they have learned. The term project evaluates whether each student has correctly applied the learned methods to their own biological problem.
blocks.ko: 본 강좌는 대학원생을 위한 생명정보학 교과목으로 (1) 기본 통계 및 가설검증 방법(hypothesis testing, multiple testing correction, Bayesian 통계 등), (2) 다변량 통계 기반 데이터 시각화 및 회귀분석(주성분분석, 다변량 회귀분석, 주요 변수 추출 등), (3) 오믹스 데이터 기본 분석(데이터 전처리 및 정규화, 매핑, 발현/활성 차이 유전자/단백질 선별), (4) 타겟 분자 예측(마이크로RNA, 전사인자 타겟 예측 등), (5) 인공지능/기계학습 기법, (6) 생체네트워크 모델링 및 분석, (7) 바이오 데이터 리소스 및 활용(지놈브라우져, 유전자변이, 단백질 수식화, 유전자/단백질 발현양, 유전자-질환 관련성 등의 다양한 데이터베이스 및 활용) 등의 생물학 연구에 있어서 유용한 기본 데이터 분석 및 리소스 활용 방법들을 학습한다. 학습한 방법들을 적용할 수 있는 텀프로젝트 과제를 부여한다. 이 텀프로젝트에서는 각자 가지고 있는 생물학적 문제에 학습한 방법을 올바르게 적용했는가를 평가한다.

blocks.en: This course teaches basic methodologies for analyzing biological data generated from conventional or global assays and also for integrating previously reported information with these data. It covers (1) Basic statistics and hypothesis testing (multiple testing correction and Bayesian statistics), (2) Multivariate statistics-based data visualization (Principal component analysis, Partial least square, classification, clustering, etc.) (3) Basic analyses of genomic/proteomic/metabolomic data (data pre-processing/normalziation, genome mapping, and identification of differentially expressed gene/proteins), (4) Target molecule prediction (microRNA and transcription factor targets), (5) AI/machine learning methods, (6) Biological network modeling and analysis, and (7) Diverse databases and applications (Genome browser, genetic alteration, post-translational modification, mRNA/protein expression, gene-disease association databases. etc.). A term project will be given, and whether the methodologies are properly applied will be evaluated.

blocks.ko: 5. 머신러닝과 인공지능을 위한 통계학 (Statistical Foundations for Machine Learning and A.I.) 3-3-0

blocks.en: Machine learning serves as a foundation for developing new statistical methodologies and algorithms. This course will teach methodologies for advanced machine learning together with their theoretical foundations. It will also present the theoretical content through the practical aspects of the methodologies and intuition, to help students choose analysis methods suited to each situation and develop analysis tools suited to their own research topics. Specifically, the course will cover topics important for machine learning research, such as nonparametric inference, concentration inequalities, optimization and variational methods.
blocks.ko: 기계 학습은 새로운 통계방법론 및 알고리즘 개발의 기반역할을 하고 있다. 이 과목에서는 고급기계학습을 위한 방법론을 이론적 기초와 함께 강의할 예정이다. 또한 방법론의 실용적 측면과 직관을 통하여 이론적 내용을 제공하여 학생들이 상황에 맞는 적절한 분석방법과 각자의 연구주제에 적합한 분석 툴에 개발하는데 도움을 주고자 한다. 구체적으로 머신러닝 연구에 중요한 비모수추론, 집중 부등식, 최적화 및 변분 방법등과 같은 주제를 다를 예정이다.

blocks.en: Machine Learning has been a fertile ground for new statistical and algorithmic developments. The course combines methodology with theoretical foundations for advanced machine learning. Theorems are presented together with practical aspects of methodology and intuition to help students develop tools for selecting appropriate methods and approaches to problems in their own research. Specifically, the course includes topics in statistical theory that are important for researchers in machine learning, including nonparametric inference, concentration inequality, optimization and variational methods.

blocks.ko: 6. 기능적자기공명영상 자료수집 및 통계분석 (Data collection and statistical analysis for functional MRI) 3-2-2

blocks.en: fMRI is a key and widely used research method in brain and cognitive science and cognitive neuroscience research on humans. This course introduces the theoretical background of how brain imaging data, including functional magnetic resonance imaging, are collected, pre-processed, analyzed and interpreted, and through hands-on practice lets students learn various statistical tools and techniques for analyzing fMRI data. This course will be useful for graduate students or senior undergraduate students who are interested in using fMRI to study the brain systems that support cognitive functions.
blocks.ko: FMRI는 인간을 대상으로 한 뇌인지과학 및 인지신경과학 연구에서 매우 핵심적인 광범위하게 활용되고 있는 연구방법이다. 이 강의는 기능적 자기공명 영상을 포함한 뇌영상 자료가 어떻게 수집, 전처리, 분석되고 해석되는 그 이론적 배경을 소개하고, 학생들로 하여금 실습을 통해 fMRI 자료를 분석하는 다양한 통계적 도구들과 기법들을 익히게 한다. 이 강의는 fMRI를 사용하여 인지기능을 뒷받침하는 뇌 시스템을 연구하는데 관심이 있는 대학원생 혹은 고학년 학부생들에게 유용할 것이다.

blocks.en: Brain and cognitive sciences use functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) as one of the key methods for studying human cognition. This course provides students with the theoretical grounds and diverse statistical tools and techniques for how fMRI data are generated, acquired, preprocessed, analyzed, and interpreted. This course will be useful for graduate or advanced undergraduate students who are interested in studying the brain systems underlying cognitive functions using fMRI.

blocks.en: ※ Note: Graduate common competency course (Interdisciplinary competency)

In the 21st century, the rapid development of AI technologies such as machine learning and deep learning, combined with big data and high-performance computers, has shown possibilities of use on a new level and is spreading quickly into industry and daily life. However, the limits of current AI, which is centered on big-data-based machine learning, are clear, and experts agree that it falls short of the technology that the founders and developers of the AI concept dreamed of. One of the keys to next-generation AI technology is building AI that resembles the natural intelligence of the brain (brain-like AI). This course aims to help students develop a future-oriented view for research and technology development in artificial and natural intelligence, through a systematic study of the similarities and differences between natural intelligence based on the brain's cognitive functions and computer-based artificial intelligence. Students from various fields who are interested in human cognition and behavior can gain insight into human uniqueness and learn about the use of AI technology by comparing artificial and natural intelligence. On the other hand, students interested in AI are expected to build the brain and cognitive science background needed to create true artificial intelligence.
blocks.ko: 21세기에 들어와 기계학습과 딥러닝 등의 AI 기술의 급격한 발전이 빅데이터와 고성능 컴퓨터와 결합되며 이전과는 다른 차원의 활용 가능성을 보여주면서 급속도로 산업과 생활에 보급되고 있다. 그러나, 현재의 빅데이터 기반 기계학습 위주 AI의 한계는 분명하며 AI 개념의 창시자와 개발자들이 꿈꾸던 기술에 못 미친다는 것이 전문가들의 한결같은 견해이다. 차세대 AI 기술의 핵심 중 하나는 뇌의 자연지능을 닮은 AI(Brain-like AI)의 구현이다. 본 교과목은 뇌의 인지기능에 기반을 둔 자연지능과 컴퓨터 기반 인공지능의 공통점과 차이점에 대한 체계적 고찰을 통해 학생들이 인공지능과 자연지능 연구 및 기술 개발을 위한 미래지향적 안목을 기를 수 있도록 돕는 것을 목표로 한다. 인간의 인지 및 행동에 관심이 있는 다양한 분야의 학생은 인공지능과 자연지능의 비교를 통해 인간의 고유성에 대한 통찰 및 인공지능 기술의 활용에 대해 배울 수 있으며, 반대로 인공지능에 관심이 있는 학생은 진정한 인공지능을 구현하기 위해 필요한 뇌인지과학적 배경을 함양할 수 있을 것으로 기대한다.

blocks.en: In the 21st century, advances in machine learning and deep learning, combined with high-performance computing and big data analytics have opened up an unmatched level of possible application of AI technology, as already evidenced in industry and everyday life. Nevertheless, there are undeniable limitations of current big data-based machine learning algorithms that make it inconsistent with the kind of “intelligence” envisioned by the founders of AI research. One of the ways in which next-generation AI might overcome some of these limitations is through the development of brain-like AI. This course will introduce students to various ways in which biological intelligence works and is implemented in the brain to provide deeper insight into the similarities and differences between biological and artificial intelligence. The goal is for students from various backgrounds interested in human cognition and behavior will gain an understanding of human uniqueness and how AI technology can be effectively utilized in studying the human mind. At the same time, those students interested in AI will gain a deeper insight into what is needed to create a truly intelligent agent through the principles of brain and cognitive sciences.

blocks.en: ※ Note: Graduate common competency course (Interdisciplinary competency)
8. 시장문제 해결 데이터 분석 (Data Analytics for Market Problem Solving) 3-2-2
blocks.ko: 8. 시장문제 해결 데이터 분석 (Data Analytics for Market Problem Solving) 3-2-2

blocks.en: Data Analytics for Market Problem Solving
blocks.ko: Data Analytics for Market Problem Solving

blocks.en: There is a need for interdisciplinary competency: thinking from the consumer's point of view, solving market problems based on scientific analysis skills using data, contributing to a better quality of life for consumers, and achieving the goals of corporate profit and the creation of social value. Through team teaching by professors specializing in retail/services, consumers and data analysis, and through industry-academia cooperation projects with companies, this course aims to train interdisciplinary talent with data analysis skills, the ability to interpret data based on an understanding of consumers, draw insights and diagnose problems, and the ability to propose improvements for retail/service companies.
blocks.ko: 소비자 중심으로 사고하면서, 데이터를 활용한 과학적 분석능력을 기반으로 시장 문제를 해결하여 소비자의 삶의 질의 증진에 기여하고, 기업의 이윤 추구 및 사회적 가치 창출이라는 목적을 달성할 수 있는 융합적 역량이 요구된다. 본 과목에서는 리테일/서비스 및 소비자, 데이터 분석 전공 교수의 집단 교수 방법과, 기업들과의 산학협력 프로젝트를 통해, 수강생들의 데이터 분석 역량과, 소비자에 대한 이해에 기반한 데이터 해석, 인사이트 도출 및 문제 진단 역량과, 리테일/서비스 기업을 위한 개선책 도출 역량을 갖춘 융합적 인재를 양성하고자 한다.

blocks.en: Converged capabilities are much needed in future market professionals. Multiple capabilities such as consumer-oriented thinking ability and data analytic skills need to be converged in order to solve market problems, and such problem solving can contribute to the improvement of consumers’ quality of life, the achievement of corporate profits and the creation of social values. In this course, through the team teaching method of professors majoring in retail/service, consumer, and data analytics, and the industry-academia cooperation projects with retail/service companies, students can enhance their capability of interpreting consumer insights, analyzing consumer data, diagnosing and solving consumers’ market problems, and suggesting strategic directions to the retail/service company.

blocks.en: ※ Note: Graduate common competency course (Interdisciplinary competency)
9. 시청각 예술 콘텐츠 제작 (AudioVisual Art Contents Production) 3-3-0
blocks.ko: 9. 시청각 예술 콘텐츠 제작 (AudioVisual Art Contents Production) 3-3-0

blocks.en: So-called audio-visual art, in which video and music come together, is widely practiced, from daily life to professional art activities, but students from different majors rarely have the chance to work together to create a piece. The purpose of this class is for students to build expertise within their own major while creating opportunities to collaborate with other majors. In this class, music students and art students will freely discuss the work they will create together, and based on this, each team will go through the training it needs. Afterwards, each team will present and perform its final work. The class aims to train experts who can plan and produce the fusion of video and music by themselves.
blocks.ko: 영상과 음악이 함께 어우러지는 이른바, 오디오-비주얼 예술은 일상생활부터 전문적인 예술 활동까지 널리 이루어지고 있으나 전공이 다른 학생들이 협력하여 작품을 구성해볼 기회가 흔치 않은 실정이다. 각각의 전공 분야 내에서 전문성을 가지고, 다른 전공과의 협력의 기회를 만들고자 하는 것이 수업의 목적이다. 따라서 본 수업에서는 음악과 학생들과 미술과 학생들이 함께 만들어갈 작품에 대해 자유롭게 의논하고, 이를 바탕으로 각 팀에서 필요로 하는 훈련과정을 거친다. 이후 각각의 팀별로 최종 작품을 발표하고 연주하며 영상과 음악 융합을 스스로 기획하고 제작하는 전문가 육성을 목적으로 한다.

blocks.en: The multimedia, so-called audiovisual art, in which video and music are mixed, is now widely carried out from daily life to professional art activities. But university students hardly have a chance for inter-departmental collaboration. The purpose of this class is to provide a unique environment of inter-departmental collaboration under guidance of each expertise. This class will allow, for instance, music- and art students to discuss freely and create a collaborative work together. Students shall be grouped and each team will get individual training for each step according to its subject. After the training session each team will present its final production. This class aims to foster expert audiovisual producer who is able to create & produce audiovisual convergent contents.

blocks.en: ※ Note: Graduate common competency course (Interdisciplinary competency)
10. 모델동물의 이해와 응용(Understanding and Application of Model Animals) 3-3-0
blocks.ko: 10. 모델동물의 이해와 응용(Understanding and Application of Model Animals) 3-3-0

blocks.en: Understanding and Application of Model Animals
blocks.ko: Understanding and Application of Model Animals

blocks.en: The course is made up of topics on model animals covering laboratory animal species in all basic and applied fields: from Drosophilia, C elegans. zebra fish, xenopus, etc., which are widely used in basic genetics and bio research, and small laboratory animals such as mice, which are widely used in biological research, up to primates.
blocks.ko: 기초 유전학 및 바이오 연구에 많이 사용되는 Drosophilia, C elegans. zebra fish, xenopus 등을 포함하여, 바이오분야 연구에 많이 사용되는 마우스와 같은 소형 실험동물부터 영장류까지, 기초 및 응용 전분야의 실험동물종을 망라하는 모델동물에 관한 주제로 구성하였다.

blocks.en: It is also organized into detailed applied topics such as bioresearch ethics, resource systems for model animals, alternative methods to animal testing, and the current status of model animals used in research on various diseases - metabolic disease models, aging and degenerative diseases, brain diseases, behavioral research, infectious diseases, tumor diseases, inflammatory diseases, genetically modified model animals, etc.
blocks.ko: 또한 생명연구윤리, 모델동물의 리소스 시스템, 동물실험대체시험법, 각종 질환연구에 활용되고 있는 모델동물의 현황 - 대사성질환모델, 노화 및 퇴행성 질환, 뇌질환, 행동연구, 감염성 질환, 종양성 질환, 염증성 질환, 유전자조작모델동물 등의 세분화된 응용 주제로 편성된다.

blocks.en: This chapter provides an introduction to the concept of animal models for biomedical research focusing on a general classification of animal models for the study of human diseases. Animal models includes many species such as Drosophilia, C elegans. zebra fish, xenopus, mice, rat, guinea pig, rabbit, dog, pig, nonhuman primate.

Animal models includes many species such as Drosophilia, C elegans. zebra fish, xenopus, mice, rat, guinea pig, rabbit, dog, pig, nonhuman primate.

blocks.en: The contents includes the ethics for research, bio-resource system, alternative experiment methods, animal models for metabolic diseases, aging models, degenerative disease, neurodegenerative diseases, infection models, cancer, inflammatory disease, genetically engineered animals. This is followed by a discussion of how knowledge concerning human biology and pathobiology can be extrapolation from results obtained from studies of animals.

blocks.en: ※ Note: Graduate common competency course (Interdisciplinary competency)
11. 데이터사이언스의 원리와 응용 (Principles and Application of Data Science) 3-3-0
blocks.ko: 11. 데이터사이언스의 원리와 응용 (Principles and Application of Data Science) 3-3-0

blocks.en: Principles and Application of Data Science
blocks.ko: Principles and Application of Data Science

blocks.en: Data science, which combines computing, machine learning algorithms and the inferential thinking of probability/statistics, offers a new paradigm for drawing insights and new knowledge from data and solving real problems based on them. This course aims to build interdisciplinary competency, such as the basic theoretical knowledge and analytical skills that graduate students from various majors need to solve problems using data. In addition, it teaches students data-centered thinking and decision-making and problem solving based on it.
blocks.ko: 컴퓨팅, 기계학습 알고리즘 및 확률/통계의 추론적 사고를 결합한 데이터사이언스는 데이터로부터 통찰력과 새로운 지식을 도출하고 이를 바탕으로 실제적인 문제를 해결하는 새로운 패러다임을 제공하고 있다. 본 과목은 여러 전공의 대학원에 들어온 학생들이 데이터를 이용해서 문제를 해결하는데 필요한 기본적인 이론 지식과 분석 능력 배양 등 융복합역량 함양을 목적으로 한다. 이에 더불어 학생들에게 데이터 중심적인 사고와 이를 통한 의사 결정 및 문제 해결도 가르친다.

blocks.en: Combining computing, machine learning algorithms, and inferential thinking based on probability/statistics, data science provides a new paradigm for deriving insights and new knowledge from data and solving real-world problems. The purpose of this course is to introduce core principles and techniques of data science such as basic theoretical knowledge and analytical skills necessary for students of various majors to solve data-driven problems. In addition, students will learn data-centric thinking and decision-making based on data.

english: - Graduate common competency courses (organized by 기초교육원 (Faculty of Liberal Education)) are divided into three areas: Basic Competency / Convergence Competency / Research Competency.

- "Common Competency Courses (Basic Competency, Convergence Competency, Research Competency)" are recognized as 전선(타전공) (major elective, other major) only up to a maximum of 3, 3 and 6 credits for Master's / Doctoral / Integrated Master's-Doctoral students respectively,
and are counted toward the credits required for graduation.
- The "Research Ethics courses" are included in the Basic Competency courses.

You must complete one of the "Research Ethics courses" (applies to students admitted from the 1st semester of 2022).
However, only up to 3 credits are recognized.
(Even if you complete more than 3 credits of Research Ethics courses, only up to 3 credits are recognized.)
★ Research Ethics courses ★
1. (Faculty of Liberal Education) M2480.000100 Understanding Research Ethics (1 credit)
2. (Common course of the College of Engineering) M1570.000300 Engineering Research Ethics and Thesis Writing (2 credits)
3. (Faculty of Liberal Education / planned to change to a Basic Competency common course from 2022) 990.501A Research Ethics (3 credits)
※ If you completed a course in the "Research Ethics course group" during your Master's program at this graduate school, you do not need to take one again in the Doctoral program.
If a student admitted before the 2022 academic year completed a common competency course, the rule is applied retroactively based on the year of graduation.
* If the Research Ethics courses taken before 2022 total more than 3 credits, they are not limited to 3 credits and are all recognized.
(Recognized as another major and counted toward the credits required for graduation)
ex)
1) Research Ethics course taken in the 1st semester of 2021 + Engineering Research Ethics and Thesis Writing taken in the 2nd semester of 2021
=> Both Research Ethics and Engineering Research Ethics and Thesis Writing (5 credits) are recognized
2) Research Ethics course taken in the 1st semester of 2021 + Engineering Research Ethics and Thesis Writing taken in the 1st semester of 2022
=> Only Research Ethics (3 credits) is recognized / the course taken in the 2022 academic year is not recognized toward the credits for course completion
* Applies to students admitted from the 1st semester of 2022
